method.requestedRoute: Three laps of forest/open/coast, 12 seconds per view, 20 m/s; wait for final tile loading before stopping.
method.sourceAssets: Identical prepared assets and world-source inputs at both source commits.
method.isolation: Sequential production runs in separate fresh headless Chrome profiles, after iRacing closed; no simultaneous builds/tests/asset encoders. Other desktop/background activity was not eliminated.
method.timing: Submitted frame count divided by browser-clock recording duration. Frame percentiles exclude the first interval, which starts before recording. Not physical display scanout or GPU completion rate.

supplemental.exploratoryNote: 29 frames, tens-of-seconds stalls, no render/load errors. This earlier harness did not record an independent wall-clock interval and included the warmup-crossing first frame in percentiles; do not use its derived FPS for the primary comparison.
supplemental.abortedAttempt: Initial capture-enabled WebGPU attempt timed out in its screenshot before measurement; excluded.

conclusion: Severe native WebGPU implementation regression in streamed-world responsiveness; no speedup established. Both builds fail steady 30 FPS acceptance.
limits: Native stalls skip phases of the wall-time-driven route; this is the same requested traversal, not equal executed camera samples or a successfully rendered three-lap route.
This is a full implementation comparison: Three and the shading/postprocessing pipelines changed; it does not isolate the graphics API or prove equal image quality.
The native repeat has only 30 frames and ten GPU timing samples. GPU timestamp distributions are not equivalent cross-backend per-frame coverage; no GPU speedup is claimed.
Main-thread render/update spans reach 51 seconds and the GPU was often lightly used between observations; shader/pipeline preparation is a suspect, not a profiled root cause.
This is streaming/teleport responsiveness, not warmed stationary-view FPS, editor FPS or physical input latency.
Initial readiness covers the world asset idle promise, not completed first-frame shader preparation.
